row:
Sukoon Physical Therapy run by Dr. Varun Wasil
BPT, MPT(orthopaedics)
Deals with the treatment of all musculoskeletal problems with Physiotherapy which includes electrotherapy, exercise therapy and manual therapy. This Physiotherapy clinic in Jalandhar provides services like diagnosis and treatment of the following :-
Treatment available for
*Back Pain
*Slip Disc
*Sciatica
*Cervical Spondylitis
*Knee Pain
*Heel Pain
*Arthritis
*Frozen Shoulder
*Bell's Palsy
*Tennis Elbow
*Sports Injuries
*Muscle & Joint Pain

This channel provides healthy information related to physiotherapy or physical therapy and also about fitness exercises for weight loss

Dr.Varun Wasil 
BPT, MPT(ORTHO)
Consultant Physiotherapist
255, Shaheed Udham Singh Nagar, Jalandhar
for appointment - 9530766255
